newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street seen slightly up but quiet.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street seen slightly up but quiet.

text.p: Wall Street is seen opening slightly higher on Thursday but trading is likely to be listless, lacking firm direction and volume because most of the week's main economic events are past, analysts said.

"I think we will open up because of the reversal late in the day yesterday," said Joseph Battipaglia, chief investment officer for Gruntal. "We picked up a lot of ground in a market which looked sloppy and could have been sloppier."
The Dow industrials closed down 12.77 points on Wednesday at 7,290.69 as investors took profits and bonds weakened.
